text:
Spencer Stastney is in his first season with Pittsburgh after stints in Nashville and Edmonton, playing about 17 and a half minutes a night. He has three assists in 16 games and hasn't played since Nov 19.

The on-ice numbers are about even: Pittsburgh gets 52% of the expected goals with him on at five on five, roughly the same as without him. That's not bad on a team that has won three of his last ten games.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking liked his offense last season: 85th percentile among defensemen in primary shot assists and 87th for chances from the home-plate area in front of the net. Evolving-Hockey noted he was better than his goals, with the chances there and the finishing not.

He's a fifth-round pick from Notre Dame, and NHL Edge has his acceleration at the 92nd percentile. What to watch: whether he gets back in the lineup, and whether the offensive tools show up in points. He's still looking for his first goal of the season.
